notes.claim: SQA's NQ Technician 1 unit asks the candidate to construct a best-fit straight line graph from supplied experimental data.
SQA's same unit outcome is to interpret graphical information and construct appropriate graphs from given numerical data.
The Maritime and Coastguard Agency's General Engineering Science I syllabus asks candidates to plot ordered pairs on graph paper and join the points with an appropriate curve.
An Illinois State University lab handbook advises against connecting even linearized data point-to-point with straight lines.
